"""Camera-guided KinDER TidyBot++ cube sorting controller."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot

r = Robot()
spec = r.spec()
axis = np.asarray(spec['arm']['axis'], float)
origin = np.asarray(spec['arm']['position_m'], float)
cam0 = np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['position_m'],float)
f0 = np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['forward'],float)
u0 = np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['up'],float)
r0 = np.asarray(spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']['right'],float)
ee0 = np.asarray(spec['arm']['end_effector']['position_m'],float)
layout = spec['proprio_layout']

def fk(q, point=cam0):
    T = np.eye(4)
    for a, p, v in zip(axis, origin, q):
        rot = Rotation.from_rotvec(a*v).as_matrix()
        U = np.eye(4); U[:3,:3]=rot; U[:3,3]=p-rot@p
        T=T@U
    return T[:3,:3]@point+T[:3,3], T[:3,:3]

def now():
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['robot_wrist'],include_depth=True)
    return obs, np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])

if __name__=='__main__':
    obs,p=now()
    q=p[6:13]
    print('odom',p[:3], 'joints',q)
    for name,point in [('camera',cam0),('grasp',ee0)]:
        x,R=fk(q,point)
        print(name,x,'forward',R@f0,'up',R@u0,'right',R@r0)
PY

def servo_joints(qtarget, yawtarget=None, max_steps=60, save=None):
    """Small closed-loop joint and yaw increments from measured encoders."""
    p=np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=['robot_wrist']).meta['proprio']['now'],float)
    for i in range(max_steps):
        q=p[6:13]
        e=np.asarray(qtarget)-q
        ye=0 if yawtarget is None else (yawtarget-p[2]+np.pi)%(2*np.pi)-np.pi
        if np.max(np.abs(e))<.02 and abs(ye)<.02: break
        a=np.zeros((1,11)); a[0,2]=np.clip(ye,-.09,.09)
        a[0,3:10]=np.clip(.8*e,-.09,.09)
        res=r.submit('delta',a,cameras=['robot_wrist'],video='none')
        p=np.asarray(res.meta['proprio']['now'],float)
        if res.meta['blocked'] or res.done: print('stopped',res.meta);break
    if save:
        from PIL import Image
        Image.fromarray(res.last['robot_wrist']).save(save)
    print('servo',i+1,'odom',p[:3],'q',p[6:13], 'steps',r.status()['control_steps'])
    return p
PY
